title: Shulker config
description: Shulker's own settings for this user, kept in config.json and applying to every project. `shulker config set` writes this file.

$schema.description: The version of this file, as a published schema URL.

providers.description: Where accounts are read from, in order. The earliest provider wins an account several hold.

default.description: The id of the account a launch uses when nothing else names one.

key.description: The CurseForge API key. SHULKER_CURSEFORGE_KEY takes priority when it is set.

instances.description: The directory shulker's own instances live in, absolute or relative to config.json's directory.

keepDays.description: How many days of runs log.jsonl keeps.

memory.description: The heap size shulker play gives the game, like 6G.

jvmArgs.description: Extra JVM arguments for those launches.

java.description: The java those launches run: the absolute path of a java binary, or of a Java home.

window.description: The window size those launches open at, like 1280x720.

wrapper.description: A command those launches run through.

saveBackups.description: How many automatic backups of a save group or instance's worlds to keep.

registry.description: The registry of the instances shulker syncs, absolute or relative to config.json's directory.

saves.description: The directory save groups live in, absolute or relative to config.json's directory.

store.description: The directory launches share versions, libraries and assets from, absolute or relative to config.json's directory.
